avoid: Heavy lifting mimes that strain the back
children.counts: Simple 1-2-3-4 counts for the mining actions.
children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' journey where children must mine salt and then 'carry' it home without dropping it.

seniors.counts: Use a steady 4/4 count for all gestures.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the mining and salt-sprinkling gestures with the arms while seated, focusing on rhythmic upper-body movement.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the traveling steps at a reduced pace, using a chair for balance during the 'mining' leans.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo by 30%; limit the depth of the mining lunges.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Gestures include mining salt, processing it, and sprinkling it on pretzels.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Moves from a localized 'mine' area to a traveling path across the floor.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes floor work (the fall) and standing sequences.
movement_profile.posture: Grounded and heavy during the mining sequences; upright and energetic during the travel sequences.

signature_moves.description: Dancers interpret the physical act of extracting salt from a cave.
signature_moves.name: The Salt Mine Mime

signature_moves.description: A solo dancer falls to the ground as if injured before rising to continue.
signature_moves.name: The Dramatic Fall

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Shifts from the weight of labor to the lightness of a journey home.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: When performing the fall, ensure proper impact distribution to avoid actual injury.

music_profile.musical_form: Narrative-driven, likely accelerating from labor to celebration
music_profile.sound_description: The soundscape follows the narrative of the salt merchant, likely beginning with steady, percussive rhythms that match the mining actions and transitioning into traditional Ukrainian folk melodies for the journey home.

basic_steps: Mimic the heavy striking and lifting motions of mining salt from a cave
Perform rhythmic movements representing the desalination of salt
Execute a symbolic gesture of sprinkling salt onto food
Transition into a traveling step representing the walk home
For the solo version: perform a controlled fall to the ground, pause, and rise quickly
teaching.formation: Can be performed as a solo or by a professional ensemble
teaching.level_notes: Requires both mimetic acting skills for the labor sequences and athletic ability for the folk dance steps and choreographed falls.
